hooks.command: jq -r '.session_id' | { read -r sid; mkdir -p /tmp/coding-agent-hooks && touch "/tmp/coding-agent-hooks/edits-${sid}.flag"; } 2>/dev/null || true

DATA=$(jq -r '[(.stop_hook_active // false | tostring), .session_id] | @tsv'); STOP_ACTIVE=$(echo "$DATA" | cut -f1); SID=$(echo "$DATA" | cut -f2); FLAG="/tmp/coding-agent-hooks/edits-${SID}.flag"; if [ "$STOP_ACTIVE" = "true" ]; then rm -f "$FLAG"; exit 0; fi; if [ ! -f "$FLAG" ]; then exit 0; fi; rm "$FLAG"; printf '%s' '{"decision":"block","reason":"Before stopping: check whether the code changes made this turn made any information in AGENTS.md obsolete. If so, update AGENTS.md to reflect reality, keep it coding-agent agnostic, and keep it under 200 lines (warn the user if it exceeds 150). If it is still accurate, briefly say so and stop."}'
